title: Carrier Delivery Terms for Online Orders Parcels
content:
**C1. Carrier.** Each Online Orders delivery service ships with its own carrier and service.

**C2. Earliest expected delivery.** The earliest expected delivery is the dispatch date plus the service's fewest transit business days. Saturday counts as a delivery day only where the service delivers on Saturdays.

**C3. Adult signature.** An order whose total is at or above the service's signature threshold is delivered only against an adult signature; a threshold of 0.00 means every order needs a signature or a pickup code.

**C4. Delivery attempts.** A delivery missed for want of a signature counts as one of the service's delivery attempts.

**C5. Holding and return to sender.** A parcel the carrier cannot deliver after the service's delivery attempts is held for the service's holding period in calendar days and then returned to sender.

## Signature: condition and result

| Signature threshold of the service | Order total | Delivered only against |
|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | Any | A signature or a pickup code |
| Above 0.00 | Below the threshold | No signature requirement from this clause |
| Above 0.00 | At or above the threshold | An adult signature |

## Worked cases (hypothetical service: 3 delivery attempts, 5-day holding period, no Saturday delivery, fewest transit days 3)

- **Earliest expected date.** Dispatched on a Thursday; three business days on, with Saturday not counting, give the following Tuesday as the earliest expected delivery.
- **Missed signature.** The first attempt fails because no adult is present to sign for an order above the threshold. That attempt counts as the first of the 3 delivery attempts.
- **All attempts used.** After the third failed attempt the carrier holds the parcel for 5 calendar days; uncollected at the end of that period, it is returned to sender.
